tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Terminal ground behind every panel. The default cell background. 256-color fallback: 233 dark, 255 light.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Status bar row, palette and slash popups, the phone strip at 80 cols. 256-color fallback: 234 dark, 255 light.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Sandbox output well and the SANDBOX tag in tool lines; the CALLS block in the approval screen. Means "contained". 256-color fallback: 232 dark, 254 light.

tokens.name: bg-select
tokens.usage: Selected row in lists (palette, slash, skills). Always paired with the ▸ marker. Only ink, ink-muted and status hues sit on it. 256-color fallback: 236 dark, 253 light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Unfocused panel borders and dividers. 3:1 on bg in both themes so panels read on a projector. 256-color fallback: 242 dark, 244 light.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: messages, tool names, values. 14.8:1 on bg (dark), 16.3:1 (light). 256-color fallback: 254 dark, 234 light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, owners, tool summaries, secondary values. At least 5.9:1 on bg, raised and select in both themes. 256-color fallback: 249 dark, 239 light.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, key-hint labels, placeholders, durations. Still 4.5:1 or better on bg, raised and sunken, so it survives a projector. Do not use it on bg-select. 256-color fallback: 246 dark, 59 light.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Decorative only: the screen behind the palette, divider rules, tree rails. Never for text that must be read. 256-color fallback: 238 dark, 250 light.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Monk's identity hue and the meaning "here and now": focused border, prompt ›, caret, running ⠹, the active plan owner, streaming ▌. 9.2:1 on bg (dark), 5.7:1 (light). 256-color fallback: 215 dark, 94 light.

tokens.name: saffron-fill
tokens.usage: Fill for the MONK lockup and the focused-panel title chip. Text on it is on-saffron. 256-color fallback: 215 dark, 215 light.

tokens.name: on-saffron
tokens.usage: Text on saffron-fill (9.0:1 dark, 7.7:1 light). 256-color fallback: 233 dark, 233 light.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success. Always with ✓ and a word (ok, recovered, passed, yes). Bluish green so it leaves the red–green axis. 256-color fallback: 79 dark, 23 light.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failure, rejection, retired, cannot undo. Always with ✗ and a word. 256-color fallback: 209 dark, 130 light.

tokens.name: fault
tokens.usage: Injected chaos. Always with ⚡ and the fault type (rate_limit, popup…). Also the chaos value in the status bar. 256-color fallback: 212 dark, 96 light.

tokens.name: skill
tokens.usage: Learned skills and learning: ↳ skill lines, ◐ verifying, win-rate bars, git shas in skill history. 256-color fallback: 117 dark, 24 light.

tokens.name: gate
tokens.usage: Needs a human: ◆ glyph, "needs your ok", the approval screen's double border. Reserved; nothing else is yellow. 256-color fallback: 221 dark, 58 light.

tokens.name: gate-fill
tokens.usage: The approval band. Text on it is on-gate. 256-color fallback: 221 dark, 221 light.

tokens.name: on-gate
tokens.usage: Text on gate-fill (13.6:1 dark, 11.8:1 light). 256-color fallback: 233 dark, 234 light.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Berkeley Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Every cell. The terminal has one size; hierarchy comes from weight, color, case and position, never size.

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: Speaker names, tool names while running, values in the status bar, key caps, panel titles.

styles.name: cell-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, used only in the approval screen and list group headers (CHAOS, RETIRED).

styles.name: projector
styles.usage: Demo setting: 120×36 on a 1920×1080 projector gives 16px cells, about a 26px font. Use weight 500 so thin strokes survive the throw.

cells.note: Spacing is counted in terminal cells (1 = one column or one row). Values are plain cell counts.

tokens.name: pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside every panel border. No vertical padding.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Panels share borders; junctions use ├ ┤ ┬ ┴. No gaps between panels.

tokens.name: col-caret
tokens.usage: Tool line: ▸/▾ expand caret at offset 1.

tokens.name: col-status
tokens.usage: Tool line: status glyph at offset 3, 2 cells wide so ⚡ (a wide char) and ✓ align.

tokens.name: col-owner
tokens.usage: Tool line: 3-letter owner (ORC RES COD OPR PHN) at offset 6.

tokens.name: col-tool
tokens.usage: Tool line: tool name at offset 10, 23 cells, truncated with …

tokens.name: col-summary
tokens.usage: Tool line: summary at offset 34; duration right-aligned 1 cell from the border.

tokens.name: indent-message
tokens.usage: Message text starts at offset 7; speaker (you, monk) at offset 1.

tokens.name: indent-detail
tokens.usage: Expanded tool detail and ↳ skill lines start at offset 6, under the owner column.

tokens.name: side-width
tokens.usage: Side column width including its right border (45 inner). Conversation gets the rest: 74 at 120 cols.

tokens.name: breakpoint-full
tokens.usage: At 120 columns and up: side panels shown. 100–119: side panels shown at 40 inner. Under 100: hidden.

tokens.name: breakpoint-min
tokens.usage: Minimum supported: 80×24. Below this Monk shows a one-line "terminal too small" notice.
